programme.desc: Rachana, an intern at a newspaper, investigates accidents occurring on a flyover with the help of a crime reporter. However, the situation changes when she is accused of murder.

programme.title: Murder 2
programme.desc: When a slew of sex workers disappear, Arjun, a former police officer, is brought in to crack the case. Subsequently, as he works undercover with Reshma, a young prostitute, she too disappears.

programme.title: Aatma: Feel It Around You
programme.desc: After losing the custody of his daughter Nia to his wife, Maya, Abhay dies in a car accident. However, his spirit continues to haunt their happy and peaceful life.

programme.title: Blank
programme.desc: A suicide bomber named Hanif loses his memory before he could complete his mission. Resultantly, the Anti-Terrorism Squad must find out his real plan and save the country from a deadly attack.

programme.title: Bheed
programme.desc: A policeman, a victim of bigotry, takes on the task of preventing migrants from crossing state borders during a major health crisis. However, tensions arise as the ground reality of prejudice emerges.

programme.title: Tejas
programme.desc: A brave Indian pilot sets on a mission to rescue a spy from Pakistan who holds confidential information and faces her inner fears from the past.

programme.title: Dil Aashna Hai
programme.desc: Laila, a cabaret dancer who grew up in a brothel, gets a call from her dying mother divulging that she was adopted. So, she takes the help of her lover, Karan, in finding out who her real parents are.

programme.title: Bhaagamathie
programme.desc: Chanchala, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth fall in love with each other. However, things take a dangerous turn when Ganpat, her brother, does not favour their relationship and plans to kill Siddharth.

programme.title: No Entry
programme.desc: A gorgeous club dancer's ill-timed rendezvous opens up a Pandora's box of lies, absurdities and misunderstandings in the lives of three quirky couples.

programme.title: Saheb, Biwi Aur Gangster 3
programme.desc: Madhvi Devi relishes her political power but worries about losing it upon her husband Aditya's release from prison. To prevent this, she recruits Uday, a gangster, to assassinate him.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Shaurya accidentally traps himself inside his new apartment, which lacks food, water and electricity. Isolated and desperate, he must endure a grueling battle against the odds to survive.

programme.title: Tumsa Nahi Dekha
programme.desc: Daksh, a wealthy alcoholic, becomes infatuated with Jia, a dancer he meets outdoors. However, Daksh risks losing his fortune if he refuses to marry Anahita.

programme.title: Omerta
programme.desc: Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh, a British terrorist of Pakistani descent, plots the kidnapping and murder of Wall Street Journal journalist Daniel Pearl.

programme.title: Vadh
programme.desc: Burdened by debt and harassed by a loan shark, a retired school teacher's life takes a drastic turn when he acts on his impulses, leading to murder.

programme.title: Aai Aai Ya Karoon Mai Kya

programme.title: Darlings

programme.title: Manikarnika: The Queen of Jhansi
programme.desc: After the death of her husband and child, Lakshmibai takes over the throne of Jhansi and defends the kingdom against the tyranny of the East India Company.

programme.title: Henna
programme.desc: Henna, a bubbly young woman based in a village in Pakistan, sets her heart on an endearing stranger who winds up there with serious injuries and no memory of his past.

programme.title: Commando 3
programme.desc: Commando Karan Singh Dogra and Inspector Bhavna Reddy race against time to thwart a terrorist attack on India. Later, they realise that foiling mastermind Buraq's plan is harder than it seems.

programme.title: Ghatothkach 2
programme.desc: Jungle prince Ghatothkach and his friends embark on an adventure-filled mission to save their land from the evil forces of Lankasoor.

programme.title: Antony Kobiyal

programme.title: Ghare and Baire
programme.desc: Amit sacrifices his dream and moves to Mumbai to declare his love to his best friend Labonya, but she comes under family pressure and agrees to a traditional arranged marriage to an NRI.

programme.title: Love Express
programme.desc: When Raktim misses his train, he's forced to spend the night at the station. However, he encounters Nilasha, a mysterious woman who sweeps him into a thrilling adventure that alters his life forever.

programme.title: Guru
programme.desc: Best friends Raja and Iqbal, who hail from different religious backgrounds, help the local people. Their friendship is at stake when Raja's brother falls in love with Iqbal's fiancée.

programme.title: Sangram
programme.desc: An idealistic village schoolmaster protests against one man's efforts to win an election campaign that is taking place in the school he teaches at and gets murdered for it.

programme.title: Bigg Boss Bangla
programme.desc: Sourav Ganguly hosts celebrity contestants as they live together in a common house, compete in various challenges and have to deal with each other's differences in order to win the prize.

programme.title: Paglu 2
programme.desc: Dev, a high-school dropout, relocates to the city in order to finish his studies. Soon, he falls in love with a girl in his college, but things go awry when she is kidnapped by a group of hoodlums.

programme.title: Paglu 2
programme.desc: Dev, a high-school dropout, relocates to the city in order to finish his studies. Soon, he falls in love with a girl in his college, but things go awry when she is kidnapped by a group of hoodlums.

programme.title: Agnishapath
programme.desc: Ajit Singh is the leader of a night guard party in a town in Punjab and lives with his wife, son and daughter. He and his family get killed by a terrorist leader.

programme.title: Ali Baba
programme.desc: Velu and his father are seasoned thieves. Their lives take a turn when a cop believes Velu is involved in the ruthless murder of several women in the city.

programme.title: Veer Abhimanyu
programme.desc: Veer Abhimanyu is about Arjuna's son Abhimanyu, describing his childhood and skill with weapons. It also tells of Abhimanyu's death in the Battle of Kurukshetra.

programme.title: Jamai Ami Hit
programme.desc: A couple deeply in love faces various obstacles while proving their earnest relationship as the girl's strong-willed mother disapproves of their bond.

programme.title: Rosogolla

programme.title: Mon Mane Na
programme.desc: On their way to Siliguri, India, Rahul and Ria bump into each other. While Rahul plans to sell a stolen necklace, Ria is excited to meet her boyfriend.

programme.title: Swamir Ghar
programme.desc: Ajay, struggling in his life, finds his troubles worsening when he falls in love with Sangita, a woman from a wealthy family and a vastly different social background.
